title: SenHub Agent release manifest
description: One manifest per release, at https://packages.senhub.io/releases/<version>/manifest.json. A new field may be added within schema_version 1; a rename, a removal or a change of meaning bumps schema_version.

version.description: Release tag, without a v prefix.

commit.description: Commit of senhub-io/senhub-agent the release is tagged at (the open-source core the build came from).

complete.description: True when every zip and MSI carries its minisign signature and, on stable, both MSIs are present. False while the Windows signing round is unfinished: do not install the Windows files of an incomplete manifest.

signing_pending.description: Names of the zip and MSI artifacts that have no minisign signature yet.

images.description: Container images published for this exact version. Empty until the image workflow has run; the manifest is regenerated afterwards.

kind.description: zip: the binary archive the auto-updater reads; msi: Windows installer; deb and rpm: Linux packages (also served by the apt and rpm repositories).

minisig_url.description: Detached minisign signature of the file, or null: deb and rpm are signed through the repository GPG key, a Windows file has none until the signing round has run.

digest.description: Manifest-list digest: pull by repo@digest to be immune to a moved tag.
